To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
solid dispersion formulations of CLX with PVP and PL X as carriers were successfully prepared and characterized.
solid dispersion formulation of poorly water soluble drug, celecoxib, with PVP and PLZ as carriers could be considered as an effective approach to improve the dissolution rate of the drug.
PVP was more effective than PLX in solid dispersions of celecoxib and PVP could be a suitable carrier for solid dispersion formulation of celecoxib.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation and characterization of solid dispersion formulations of CLX using two different carriers.
the development and characterization of CLX solid dispersions using PVP and PL X.
the development of solid dispersion formulations for CLX, which may improve the dissolution rate and bioavailability of the drug.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
PVP and PLK are both suitable carriers for solid dispersion formulation of drugs with low aqueous solubility.
solid dispersion formulation is a suitable strategy to improve the dissolution rate and oral bioavailability of CLX.
solid dispersions of CLC:PVP are more promising than CLX:PLC solid dispersions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
PVP could be used as a suitable carrier for solid dispersion formulation of celecoxib to improve dissolution rate of the drug.
solid dispersions of CLx: PVP at a 1:4 drug:carrier ratio is the most appropriate formulation.
the dissolution rate of solid dispersion formulations of CLX could be improved by using suitable carrier.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the effect of carrier type and ratio on dissolution rate should be carefully investigated in solid dispersion formulation.
the dissolution of drug from the solid dispersion is a complex process and it depends not only on the Tg of the solid dispersion, but on the drug: carrier ratio as well.
solid dispersions are a viable option to enhance the dissolution and bioavailability of poorly soluble drugs.
